label: dissertation_v4_orca_fusion_m10_ultra_quiet_na013
description: Active dissertation optical and detector defaults for the repository-designated representative Oxford bimodal state. The ideal isolated-line polarised 166Er response is fixed for the primary PCI and secondary DGI eigenmode, while the effective NA=0.130 design, multilevel apparatus response and catalogue-typical detector values remain commissioning inputs until measured.

reference_state_selector.selection_basis: repository-designated representative repetition fixed before simulation-outcome inspection; central is not an Oxford CSV field

polarised_atomic_response.model_status: ideal isolated-401-nm-line, fully polarised, weak-probe screening model; not a calibrated multilevel apparatus response

geometry.rotation_policy: if B rotates within the y-z plane, keep epsilon_hat proportional to k_hat cross B_hat
geometry.geometry_role: project-selected ideal across-cigar imaging design; not a transcription of the Oxford absorption arm

polarised_atomic_response.spherical_basis_convention: q is defined relative to +B; q=-1 drives m_J=-6 to m_J'=-7, q=+1 drives m_J=-6 to m_J'=-5

detuning_convention.detuning_hz: the common-detuning value is probe frequency minus the midpoint reference of the two driven branch frequencies; explicit branch detunings, when supplied, are probe frequency minus each branch frequency, in cycles per second
detuning_convention.common_detuning_boundary: at B=1.4 G the two driven sigma branches are separated by 4.546 MHz; each branch is displaced by 2.273 MHz, or 0.152%, from the midpoint of the 1.5 GHz reference detuning; exact branch detunings remain available for coherent-response sensitivity checks

rank_factors.operator_convention: K = k0 I + i k1 [B_hat cross] + (k2/2)(3 B_hat B_hat - I)
rank_factors.transverse_projection_convention: The physical Jones response is K_perp = P_k K P_k on the plane perpendicular to k_hat, with P_k = I - k_hat k_hat^T; all linear-eigenmode labels and eigenvalues in this config refer to K_perp, not to the unprojected three-dimensional K
rank_factors.longitudinal_component_policy: discard the longitudinal component generated by the unprojected rank-1 term, consistently with a paraxial transverse field; arbitrary non-paraxial or vectorial propagation is outside this model

selected_branches.label: sigma_minus
selected_branches.closure_status: cycling within the selected J=6 to J'=7 manifold; metastable leakage is excluded

selected_branches.label: pi
selected_branches.closure_status: non-cycling control branch; absent from the selected perpendicular eigenmode

selected_branches.label: sigma_plus
selected_branches.closure_status: weak non-cycling branch within the selected manifold

polarised_atomic_response.complex_object_convention: t(y,z) = exp[-OD(y,z)/2 + i*phi(y,z)]; phase and OD are coherent branch sums and the common-detuning selected-mode factor is applied exactly once
polarised_atomic_response.scattering_convention: construct each non-negative branch saturation numerator, sum them once in the shared denominator, then sum branch rates; never multiply a saturated unit-strength total by 46/91
validity: uniform B and a fully prepared J=6,m_J=-6 state
selected transverse linear eigenpolarisation epsilon_hat proportional to k_hat cross B_hat
weak probe, isolated J=6 to J'=7 line and common branch detuning
independent-atom thin complex object within one exposure
excluded: nearby erbium levels and a calibrated multilevel complex polarizability
viewport ellipticity, polarisation impurity and spatial B or spin texture
cumulative optical pumping and open-channel metastable leakage
arbitrary Jones superpositions and coherent Raman dynamics

readout_selection.selection_basis: both use the same selected transverse-projected rank-0 plus rank-2 eigenmode complex object and differ only in Fourier-plane reference handling

imaging_geometry.imaging_axis_note: axis 0 is the project-selected ideal across-cigar x direction; the plotted transverse plane is y,z. The Oxford source absorption axis is instead reported at 22.5 degrees to a tight trap axis.
imaging_geometry.oxford_source_imaging_geometry: absorption axis in the horizontal plane at 22.5 degrees to a tight trap axis
imaging_geometry.focal_length_1_role: effective object-side focal length of the active NA=0.130 design; with the 24 mm entrance pupil it gives NA=(D/2)/f=0.130
imaging_geometry.focal_length_2_role: legacy relay entry retained for optical-model compatibility; it is not used to infer the active camera magnification
imaging_geometry.magnification_status: current experimental design value; achieved magnification remains to be measured during commissioning
imaging_geometry.camera_pixel_role: catalogue physical sensor pitch; code divides by magnification exactly once

faraday_recovery.kappa_F_status: ideal atomic-response coefficient for the fully spin-polarised 166Er reference state probed along the quantisation axis; apparatus-level response remains to be calibrated

camera_recovery.sampling_note: The optical grid remains 100 um/1024. A centred 153x153 analysis crop is integrated at the exact 0.650 um object-plane pitch; it is not claimed to be a directly programmed hardware ROI. ORCA-Fusion sub-array dimensions are set in multiples of four pixels, so commissioning must acquire a legal selected-readout ROI containing this analysis crop.
camera_recovery.camera_exposure_role: shortest calculated Ultra quiet exposure setting that contains the 300 us optical pulse at the F=300 mW us, P=1 mW reference; tau in F=P tau remains the optical pulse duration and is placed inside a verified common-exposure interval
camera_recovery.quantum_efficiency_note: catalogue typical QE at 400 nm, used provisionally for the 401 nm transition until effective in-path response is measured
camera_recovery.read_noise_note: manufacturer-typical rms value for Ultra quiet scan; to be verified with dark frames for the installed camera, ROI and trigger sequence
camera_recovery.read_noise_treatment: base single-frame Ultra quiet recovery input only; Chapter 5 acquisition screening must override this field with the Gate 6d/Gate 7 Fast 1.4 e- rms contract, while 0.7 e- rms is reserved for Chapters 6-7 sensitivity
camera_recovery.pulse_timing_requirement: use a global-reset trigger or place the probe pulse inside a verified common-exposure interval shared by every row of the selected PCI or DGI readout region
camera_recovery.dual_port_sampling: Faraday-only historical compatibility: both Wollaston outputs are represented as simultaneous regions of interest on one sensor; this is not a PCI/DGI ROI requirement

multishot_recovery.recoil_energy_convention: complete absorption-spontaneous-emission cycle deposits 2 E_rec per primary or reabsorbed scattering event

noisy_multishot_filmstrip_recovery.profile_convention: fresh-cloud image formation with the evolving frame state supplied by the full multishot model

status_note: Active ORCA-Fusion/M=10 optical-detector configuration with the Oxford state resolved by source path, condition ID and repetition ID. The source dipole geometry is separated from the project-selected ideal k=x imaging axis. Gates 1-5 fix the conditional polarised dipolar-TF core, ideal isolated-line rank-0 plus rank-2 PCI/DGI contract, absolute optics and non-canonical Figure 4.2 validation. Chapter 5 Gate 6-7 consumers override the base Ultra quiet read-noise field with Fast 1.4 e- rms. No retained successor figure is admitted.
